parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The domain names for which to customize reports. If you do not specify this parameter, operations reports are customized for all domain names under your account by default.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the task. Use the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: ReportIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the reports to customize. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). Call the [DescribeDcdnSubList](~~270075~~) operation to query report IDs.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the task. Use the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.
